gloss: plants and animals; flora and fauna

definitions.gloss: plants and animals; flora and fauna; wildlife
definitions.explanation: A collective term covering both animals ({動物|どうぶつ}) and plants ({植物|しょくぶつ}). Used in discussions of biodiversity, ecosystems, nature conservation, and regional wildlife.

examples.japanese: ⟦{珍|めずら}しい→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧{動植物|どうしょくぶつ}。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{固有|こゆう}→固有：05615_koyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{動植物|どうしょくぶつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This island has many endemic plants and animals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{気候|きこう}{変動|へんどう}→気候変動：04627_kikouhendou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{動植物|どうしょくぶつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えている→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: Climate change is affecting plants and animals around the world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国立|こくりつ}{公園|こうえん}→国立公園：17724_kokuritsukouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{多様|たよう}→多様：12180_tayou⟧な{動植物|どうしょくぶつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Diverse plants and animals are protected in national parks.

notes:
Compound formed by abbreviating ⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧ ('animal') and ⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧ ('plant') and joining them under a single ⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧. The ordering (animals first, then plants) is fixed — the reverse order is not used.

USAGE:
A convenient umbrella term frequently used in scientific, educational, and conservation contexts where one wants to refer to living things in general without repeating ⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧. Common in museum exhibits, field guides, environmental reports, and school science materials.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{珍|めずら}しい→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧{動植物|どうしょくぶつ}: rare plants and animals
- ⟦{固有|こゆう}→固有：05615_koyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{動植物|どうしょくぶつ}: endemic flora and fauna
- {動植物|どうしょくぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧: conservation of plants and animals
- {動植物|どうしょくぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生態|せいたい}→生態：13543_seitai⟧: the ecology of plants and animals
- ⟦{多様|たよう}→多様：12180_tayou⟧な{動植物|どうしょくぶつ}: diverse flora and fauna
- ⟦{絶滅|ぜつめつ}→絶滅：03756_zetsumetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧{動植物|どうしょくぶつ}: endangered plants and animals

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧: animal
- ⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧: plant
- ⟦{生物|せいぶつ}→生物：03295_seibutsu⟧: living things; organisms — broader, includes microbes
- ⟦{野生|やせい}{動物|どうぶつ}→野生動物：09251_yaseidoubutsu⟧: wildlife (animals only)
- ⟦{生態系|せいたいけい}→生態系：04626_seitaikei⟧: ecosystem — the system in which {動植物|どうしょくぶつ} live
